# Vendored Datastar client

Exact `bundles/datastar.js` from [starfederation/datastar v1.0.1](https://github.com/starfederation/datastar/releases/tag/v1.0.1).

`@starfederation/datastar` is not published at 1.0.1 on npm (latest there is `1.0.0-beta.11`), so this pin is vendored same-origin instead of loaded from jsDelivr.
